Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: The study focuses on land-use change projections along the Silk Road—a transboundary, multi-country region spanning parts of Asia, Europe, and Africa—rather than implementing analysis at an explicit national scale for any single country. Although it includes national-level data (e.g., China, India), the primary spatial unit of analysis is a set of nine aggregated sub-regions (e.g., “China (CHN)”, “Other Asian countries (OAS)”, “Eastern Europe (EEU)”), which do not constitute a single nation’s full territory as required by the core inclusion criterion of "explicit national-scale spatial implementation (entire country)". Furthermore, the paper’s scope is inherently transnational and comparative across regions, violating the exclusion criterion: “Local/regional/global/transboundary scale focus”. While the paper conducts LULC prediction with multiple scenarios, spatial modeling, and quantitative metrics, it fails the mandatory national-scale requirement for non-review papers.)
